Grand Prix name.

How many results rows this driver had in this race before the collapse.
How many constructors those rows used.

Official position text, including R, D, W, F, N. Not a legal model feature.
Dense rank of every starter, including retirements. The brief defines the label from this column. Not a legal model feature.
Points scored in this race. Not a legal model feature.
Laps completed. Not a legal model feature.
Finishing status. Not a legal model feature.
